newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ITALY SQUAD FOR TOURNOI DE FRANCE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ITALY SQUAD FOR TOURNOI DE FRANCE.

text.p: Italy named the following 23-man squad on Friday for the four-nation Tournoi de France starting on Tuesday:

Angelo Peruzzi, Gianluca Pagliuca, Ciro Ferrara, Alessandro Costacurta, Fabio Cannavaro, Paolo Maldini, Antonio Benarrivo, Christian Panucci, Alessandro Nesta, Stefano Torrisi, Angelo Di Livio, Roberto Di Matteo, Demetrio Albertini, Dino Baggio, Diego Fuser, Giampiero Maini, Eusebio Di Francesco, Christian Vieri, Filippo Inzaghi, Gianfranco Zola, Pierluigi Casiraghi, Alessandro Del Piero, Enrico Chiesa.
